title: CibusTec 2026: Making more value from every ingredient
summary: That’s a wrap for CibusTec 2026, but it’s just the start for processors who want to make more value from every ingredient.
body_markdown:
##### Quality demonstrated in the physical machines


The Virtual Hub is a great tool for seeing the bigger picture, but nothing replaces getting close to a physical machine. Visitors to the stand agreed with a lot of interest shown in how our[Sterideal® Ohmic](https://jbtmarel.com/en/products/sterideal-ohmic-heat-exchanger/) sterilizes fruit and vegetable preparations to the highest safety standards, while preserving the taste, texture and nutritional value customer demand.


The[RevoPortioner](https://jbtmarel.com/en/products/revoportioner/) and[TREIF HAWK portion cutter](https://jbtmarel.com/en/products/treif-hawk-portion-cutter/) drew considerable interest from processors in all proteins looking to improve weight-accuracy and increase the flexibility of their portioning lines.


For freezing options, the GYRoCOMPACT[range of freezers](https://jbtmarel.com/en/jbt-marel-freezing-solutions/) reminded everyone just why it’s become known for state-of-the-art freezing with operating simplicity.


##### Good partnership goes beyond installation


We know performance doesn’t stop at installation, at CibusTec 2026 our Software specialists were kept busy showing how AXIN Solutions offers a module way to integrate software into processing lines and gain insights from real-time data that drive constant improvements. Our Service team was kept busy discussing how ongoing service helps protect uptime, optimize equipment overtime and get processors more from their investments.


“It’s been a busy few days,” said Jacopo Montali, JBT Marel Sales Director. “The central challenges visitors have been talking about is the increased cost of power and gas and how JBT Marel can help address that. In particular, we’ve been having a lot of interest in our Service portfolio. Processors are really seeing the benefits of having online performance monitoring and predictive maintenance running on their machines the whole time.”


Thank you to everyone who stopped by the stand to share their industry challenges and explore how JBT Marel has the portfolio and expertise to help solve them. We look forward to continuing the conversation.
